newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslavia 1996 sugar beet seen at 2.3 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslavia 1996 sugar beet seen at 2.3 mln tonnes.

text.p: Yugoslavia's sugar beet output is expected to increase by 37 percent to 2.3 million tonnes this year, the statistics office said.
Tihomir Madic of the Association of Serbian Cooperatives said sugar output was seen at about 250,000 tonnes.
"This year's sugar production along with sugar imports to date should just about satisfy domestic needs," Madic said.
Yugoslavia imported 100,000 tonnes of raw sugar at the beginning of the year and 40,000 tonnes of refined sugar in the first half of the year.
"Further imports are not justified," Madic said.
This year's expected average yield from 70,000 hectares under beet is 33.3 tonnes per hectare, up 5.9 tonnes on 1995.
The area increased by about 8,000 hectares this year.
